title: Bought it on recommendation..
text:
Bought it on recommendation... I really did not know what to expect, and upon arrival I was both pleased and disappointed.

Disappointment: The size of the box is so tiny, I would think for my money I would have got a bit more sandalwood powder. After all, in powder form the wood is going to be fluffier and airy, thus a small box promises even smaller contents. I took a photo with my medium-sized lady hand beside the box for size reference.

Pleasant surprise: Upon opening the plastic bag within the box, I got a potent whiff of sandalwood. This is the real McCoy! That, alone, made me very, very happy.

I am ecstatic to make use of this in incense recipes. I will most likely buy more in the future despite the modest amount. On a side note, I think if you cut it with some other wood which has a lower scent value, you can easily stretch this amount without losing its potency.

description: This Sandalwood is directly ground into powder from raw Old Mountain series Sandalwood. No chemical additions or perfume added. We guarantee there is no extraction of sandalwood essential oil before making this powder incense. There are multiple usages for this sandalwood powder. Here this item was prepared to be used as incense only.  If you use for cosmetic purpose, we suggest you to sterilize before pasting on face or skin.

In "Outline Treatise of Medical Herbs", it states the Sandalwood: the medicinal is mild and smell is fragrant. It can help adjust the spleen and lung, benefit to chest diaphragm and exorcise evil spirits. It benefits the stomach and raises the desire for food. It is an important medicine to help adjust the vital energy. It is widely be used in religious pray, offering sacrifices to gods or ancestors and giving scent. It can also be used with other fragrance powder and is the indispensable incense in studying the dharma.
